content: app.enableShutdownHooks() must be called explicitly (disabled by default) for onModuleDestroy/beforeApplicationShutdown/onApplicationShutdown to fire on SIGTERM; without it the process dies immediately, dropping in-flight writes and connections. Correct sequence on SIGTERM: stop accepting new connections/requests, wait (bounded timeout) for in-flight handlers to finish, close DB pool, close SSE upstream, then exit. Missing a shutdown timeout risks hanging indefinitely on lingering keep-alive connections.
